d:
Enjoy The Evergreen Kannada Lyrical Song “Nagutha Nagutha Baalu” From The Classic Kannada Movie Parashuram, Starring The Legendary Dr. Rajkumar And Mahalakshmi.
Relive The Nostalgia Of This Beautiful Kannada Song With Its Memorable Lyrics And Timeless Music.
If You Love Dr. Rajkumar Songs, Puneeth Rajkumar Songs, Hamsalekha Hits, Old Kannada Songs And Evergreen Kannada Movie Songs.
Directed by: V. Somashekhar
Produced by: Parvathamma Rajkumar
Written by: T. N. Narasimhan
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Mahalakshmi
Music Director: Hamsalekha
